tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Day 6 — third round: Pegula vs Fernandez, Alcaraz vs Wu Yibing, Shelton vs Shapovalov; Khachanov stunned Auger-Aliassime overnight as Swiatek, Osaka and Gauff advance • [SQUASH] London Classic quarter-finals at Alexandra Palace — Yow Ng upset Eleinen to reach the last eight; semi-finals Saturday • [BADMINTON] China Masters quarter-finals in Shenzhen — Kidambi Srikanth faces Lee Cheuk Yiu; Satwik-Chirag take on Astrup-Rasmussen • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals quarter-finals in Cary — PPA Major worth 2,000 ranking points; PickleballTV and Tennis Channel from 10am ET • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Europe Cup group-stage draw completed; HYLO Champions League Stage 2 Round of 16 set — Saarbrücken vs Lille Metropole among eight ties

newsItems.title: Khachanov Stuns Auger-Aliassime at US Open
newsItems.excerpt: Karen Khachanov knocked out third seed Felix Auger-Aliassime 6-7, 6-3, 6-2, 6-2 as Iga Swiatek, Naomi Osaka and Coco Gauff all reached the third round on Day 5 — Pegula, Alcaraz and Shelton headline Day 6.

newsItems.title: London Classic Quarter-Finals Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Gold London Squash Classic reaches the quarter-final stage at Alexandra Palace — Malaysia's Eain Yow Ng upset Youssef Eleinen to join the last eight as semi-finals loom on Saturday.

newsItems.title: China Masters Quarter-Finals Begin
newsItems.excerpt: The Super 750 in Shenzhen enters the business end — Kidambi Srikanth faces Lee Cheuk Yiu after beating Victor Lai, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty take on Denmark's Astrup-Rasmussen.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Reach Quarter-Finals
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Major in Cary moves into quarter-final Friday with 2,000 ranking points on the line — over 1,400 players in the draw as the new World Pickleball Rankings debut at the season opener.
